title: SF464 (2019-2020 Regular): Taylor Hayden Gun Violence Prevention Act; appropriation

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (1st  Engrossment; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2019/0/SF/464/versions/1/)

operative_text:
Section 1 (Taylor Hayden Gun Violence Prevention Act, uncodified): To reduce the number of injuries and deaths of innocent individuals in the community and to increase community safety, the commissioner of health shall develop a competitive bidding process to award grants to nonprofit organizations with expertise in gun violence prevention. A nonprofit organization awarded a grant must use the money for gun violence prevention or public awareness and education campaigns on gun violence prevention.
Section 2 (appropriation, uncodified): $200,000 in fiscal year 2020 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2021 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health to provide grants described in section 1.
